svg.title: Guard chain and audit
svg.desc: Tool calls intercepted from claude, codex, ACP agents and inbound /mcp run through one layered GuardChain per runner: four base guards read live, then the per-execution TaskToolFilterGuard. The first block wins and the call is denied; warn and block verdicts flow through onVerdict to the daily NDJSON audit log.

g.text: Hover a box for what it checks or records; its connections light up. Click it to open its section.
Inside a rendered document this image is static. Click it to open the interactive SVG.

svg.text: First block wins. A guard that throws or times out blocks, or warns when guards.fail_open is set.

g.class: e join f-claude f-codex f-acp f-mcp t-g1
e main f-claude f-codex f-acp f-mcp t-g1

g.text: claude · Claude Code calls the registered PreToolUse hook (no matcher) before every tool
The callback evaluates the chain and answers deny on block; a hook exception also denies.
codex · command, file-change and MCP approval requests are the only interception point
Under approval policy never, codex emits no requests and the chain is not consulted at all.
ACP agent · host-advertised fs reverse calls map to file_read and file_write, bound to the active turn
Terminal reverse calls are not advertised, so an ACP agent cannot run shell commands through the host.
/mcp tools/call · inbound MCP dispatch evaluates the base chain only
No runner, so no TaskToolFilterGuard; one AuditEntry is written per dispatch.
Blocks destructive, force, fork-bomb, interpreter-escape and blocked pipe-target patterns.
shell paths, file tools: glob levels
FileGuard · glob rules with no_access, read_only and no_delete levels over resolved paths
The most restrictive matching rule wins; Claude Grep and Glob search roots are checked too.
NetworkGuard · domain allowlist; blocks literal IP hosts and exfiltration patterns
agent_overrides add domains per logical agent.
ToolPolicyGuard · ToolPolicyCascade over canonical tool names
Global deny binds every agent including main; agent deny and a non-empty agent allow bind logical agents.
TaskToolFilterGuard · rebound each turn from the active lease
A null allowlist is unrestricted; an empty one closes only under denyEmptyAllowlist. Read-only mode admits only read-only shell.
block · the first block short-circuits the chain
A guard that throws or exceeds its evaluation budget yields a failure verdict: block, or warn when guards.fail_open is set.
the tool runs; the first warn is returned
pass or warn · no guard blocked
Each warn is reported through onVerdict; the chain returns the first warn, else pass. Pass is never audited.
GuardBlockEvent · carries guard, hook, canonical tool, raw provider tool, agent, session and peer
EventBus.fire swallows subscriber exceptions, so a broken subscriber cannot fail a tool call.
GuardAuditSubscriber · bridges the event bus to the audit logger
Pass verdicts are never recorded by the chain.
GuardAuditLogger · logs at INFO, WARNING or SEVERE and appends to the day partition
Writes chain through one future, so verdict latency never waits on disk.
decision sites · egress, /mcp dispatch, run, task and knowledge gates, DB egress, Slack signatures
These call writeEntry and await it, so the caller can fail closed and refuse the action.
audit-YYYY-MM-DD.ndjson · AuditEntry lines in the data directory, one file per day
Retention defaults to 30 days, 0 keeps all. Entries are not hash-chained or signed.
